Motion For Prove-P Hearing For Default Judgment Against Deft; Memo Of P&A; Declaration
Off Calendar Aug-16-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for Court Trial/Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 514, Judge: Judge: Donald J. Sullivan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong #11288.
Richard Stromberg, Esq. appeared for plaintiff Coastdise Lumber and Supply, Inc. dba South City Lumber and Supply.
Plaintiff Witness David Azzopardi, was placed under oath and direct examined.
No appearance by defaulted defendant Ibrahim Ahmed.
Default of Defendant(s) has been duly entered.
After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendant as follows:

Principal - $37,714.85
Prejudgment Interest - $22,295.77
Attorney's fees - $8,387.50
Costs - $792.00, for a total judgment in the amount of $69,190.12
Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
